notes.subject: רעו
notes.rationale: Re'u: e ka ba 'mogwera wa gagwe' (ra'ah friend) goba 'modumo wa wona' (crash/thunder — bjalo ka KJV/JPS); ke yona bothata bja temana ye.

notes.subject: עולה
notes.rationale: 'olah: e ka ba 'go namelega' ga phefo/mollo (KJV 'vapour', ASV 'storm') goba 'sehlabelo sa go fišwa'; Šeberu se bua fela go namelega.

notes.subject: mogwera
notes.rationale: Ge re bala רעו bjalo ka ra'ah: 'o tsebiša mogwera wa gagwe ka sela', sekao sa YLT.

notes.subject: את
notes.rationale: ⟨את⟩ e swara selo se se tsebišwago; Sepedi ga se e nyakele.

translation: Modumo wa wona o tsebiša ka ⟨את⟩ yena; diruiwa gape ka seo se namelego.
